name: follow-through
description: Project-agnostic gates on how an agent ends its turn and how parallel sessions coexist: no stopping on an announcement, no prose questions, no handing work back, no 'it works' on unseen screens, plain outbound texts, a prompt before destructive commands, a shared registry so sessions see each other, lanes that start from the freshest integration branch, and a status file kept current in the same turn.
